summary:
Turn 42 reproduced the confirmed recovery finding in the deployed variant and recorded the exact validation constraint that blocked fixing it as a check this turn.

The variant result (construction knowledge until fixed as a check). A harness identical to the reviewed C1 variant except that the recovering replica has IsLeader true and maxRecvBallot 5 showed: startRecoveryForInstance makes ballot 6 and reports it as the replica's own VBallot (seed_lb_ballot -1, record_vbal_reported_by_self 6), the peer's COMMITTED reply at vbal 0 is skipped (adopted_committed false), the accept round completes (accept_oks 0 to 1), the recoverer commits NOOP while the peer keeps PUT (vectors_match false; replica0 NONE, replica1 PUT, replica2 NONE), and the applied state diverges (peer 04 against (void)). Since the shipped aws.conf designates a leader and the master promotes through Replica.BeTheLeader, this is the deployed case rather than an artificial one, and IsLeader only raises the ballot further: the comparison that keeps the committed reply out is unchanged.

Why it is not yet a formal check. Two validator constraints were hit and are recorded verbatim for the next attempt: a plan whose claim grounding, harness legality and monitors referenced an existing binding was rejected as using non-selected bindings, while one that referenced only the new binding supplied with the candidate was rejected as referencing unavailable code bindings. The accepted shape for a fresh obligation's bindings therefore needs one more attempt (the earlier successful obligations differ in how the candidate patch and the plan are ordered, which is what I will line up next).

The result is recorded with the sources that make the variant real (the recovery entry, the resolution loop, the master's promotion and the shipped configuration) as construction knowledge, and the two remaining items are the binding shape and whether a promoted replica is commonly the recovery leader. Audit spec version 9; the five settled claims and their scopes are untouched — C1 still records the non-promoted case — and no requirement, premise or earlier observation was weakened.
